name: Pipeliners - Schema and Headings Report 2026-08-19
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-08-19

# Summary
Work report "City page schema + heading fixes" (Aug 18-19).

# Problems found
- The 3 priority pages (/buckeye/, homepage, /paradise-valley/) had 5,836 impressions and 27 clicks in 90 days, all brand.
- No LocalBusiness schema anywhere; the same generic H2 block copied across pages; Buckeye's visible H1 showed "| Pipeliners USA"; Buckeye drew 441 impressions for gas line work Pipeliners does not sell.

# Done
- Audited the 3 pages against the live top 10.
- Built and deployed Service + LocalBusiness schema to all 37 city pages from GBP data (37 of 37 verified).
- Rewrote the Buckeye and homepage H1s, promoted service headings to H2 on Buckeye and Paradise Valley, rewrote the generic H2 block on 4 pages.
- Found that OTTO was targeting Buckeye at "gas line repair buckeye" with 20 junk keyword terms (including "ohio state university").
- Protected two rankings ("Pipe Repair in Buckeye" position 6, "Trenchless Sewer Repair in Paradise Valley" position 8). Fixed broken /avondale/ schema.

# Trade-offs noted
OTTO caps edits at 2,000 characters; the 4.9 rating in schema was not visible on page (Kim left it then); OTTO schema 4517 showed deployed but rendered nowhere; blank bands and black video blocks pointed to LiteSpeed JS Minify.

# Superseded
- The report says GBP confirmed Pipeliners is "genuinely open 24/7" and suggests adding 24/7, prices and review counts to copy. Scott's Oct 1 answers reverse this: no 24/7, no prices. The 24/7 hours and the rating were removed from 32 city-page schemas on Oct 8.
- Gas line work: confirmed not a service.
